GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Inside 5 Lengths off leader/winner locked away nowhere to go until the 300m then couldn't quicken - # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m was bumped. Held up for clear running from the 400m until after passing the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along comf Went Forward Settled Down Narrow Lead Inside led x 1 Lengths x 600m, nursed to 300m Collared x 200m, couldn't finish off - # led, gave all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden more forward; led. Raced keenly in the lead through the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on ok but never a threat # not the worst

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back near last 4l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the mare, which was racing first up today, raced far too keenly throughout the early stages of the event and, as a consequence, was left without a finishing effort. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong making good ground taking lead in the shadows. # back/ran on strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported she intended to ride her mnt in a forward position, however when it became apparent in the early stages it would be caught wide, she elected to shift in behind runners. Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped ok , sat 3 Wide 3rd, 2 Lengths @ 900m. No Cover . much the same to straightening up . kept on. 1st 2 out 1st 2 home # wide/held ground ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout.
